Architecture: links-as-UI and client handlers\n\n### 2.1 UI stored as links\n\nA UI component is a **code link** plus **binding links**:\n\n```\n(handler: Handler clientSupportsJs -> tsxCodeLink)      # \"this code runs in the browser\"\n(handleClient: HandleClient SomeType -> handler)        # \"render links of SomeType with it\"\n```\n\n- The code link (type `TSX`, `@deep-foundation/core`) holds a string value of the form\n  `({deep, require}) => { const React = require('react'); ... return Component }`.\n- `deep._findHandler({ handlerId, context })` (deeplinks `imports/client.tsx` ~L2277) queries the\n  `handlers` table filtered by the JS execution provider. Without `handlerId` it matches a\n  `@deep-foundation/deepcase` `Context` link among the context ids — i.e. handler choice is\n  context-sensitive and itself a link query.\n- `evalClientHandler` (deeplinks `imports/client-handler.tsx`) runs `eval(value)`, expects a\n  function, calls it with `{deep, gql, require, ...input}`, and renders the returned component.\n- `require` is a **whitelist map** (`r.list` in deepcase `imports/client-handler.tsx`) of\n  packages: react, chakra, framer-motion, monaco, cytoscape, recharts, d3, etc. Heavier modules\n  are resolved lazily through `DeepClient.resolveDependency`.\n- `CatchErrors` is an error boundary that renders a Chakra `Alert` with a reset button.\n  Perception replaces it with `ClientHandlerErrorComponent` (modal, src/dist toggle, FinderButton).\n- `ClientHandlerRenderer` props: `fillSize`, `onClose`, `linkId`, `handlerId`, `context`.\n\n### 2.2 Package-defined handlers (`deep.json` of deepcase)\n\n| Handler                  | Bound to types                       |\n| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |\n| `asyncFileClientHandler` | AsyncFile (image/video/file preview) |\n| `stringClientHandler`    | Join, PackageQuery, Contain          |\n| `queryClientHandler`     | Query                                |\n| `editorClientHandler`    | SyncTextFile, TSX                    |\n\nOther types declared: `Traveler` (Any -> Query, symbol 🧳), `ContextToken`, `Context`.\n\n### 2.3 HandleCyto — graph rendering as links\n\n`@deep-foundation/handle-cyto` defines `HandleCyto`: a handler that returns Cytoscape `elements`\nand `stylesheets` for links of a given type (`imports/cyto-handler.tsx`). Example:\n`HandleCytoContainInvisible` hides Contain edges. Rules can be toggled per handler\n(`useCytoHandlersRules`). So **per-type visual representation is data**, not code in the shell.\n\n### 2.4 State stores\n\n`@deep-foundation/store` provides one hook API over three backends:\n`useQueryStore` (URL query, shareable), `useLocalStore` (localStorage), `useCookiesStore`.\nExamples: `useSpaceId`, `useContainer` (query store); `layout`, `editor-tabs` (local store).\n\n### 2.5 Perception (second generation)\n\n- `perception-imports/imports/go.tsx` (927 lines): `GoI`, `GoProvider`, `useGo` — navigation as a\n  chainable cursor (`go.focus`, `go.do`, `go.parents`) with `History` / `HistoryHandler` links.\n- `perception-imports/imports/react-handler.tsx`: `ReactHandler`, `ReactHandlersProvider`,\n  `createComponent` — handlers usable as plain React components.\n- `perception-app/pages/index.tsx`: the **whole app shell is a handler** —\n  `<go.Handler handlerId={deep.idLocal('@deep-foundation/perception-links','Layout')} Auth={...} Status={...} ColorMode={...}/>`.\n  The shell supplies only slot components (auth slide-out panel, status indicator, color mode).\n- Also: Telegram web-app script, regenerable `preloaded.json` (handlers bundled offline).\n\n### 2.6 The 2025 rewrite (`deep-foundation/deep`)\n\nNext 15 app router, MUI 6 dark theme (`src/theme.tsx`) with a **per-JS-value-type palette**\n(`types.value/symbol/undefined/promise/boolean/string/number/bigint/set/weakSet...`, each with\nmain/light/dark), black canvas page rendering an echarts graph (`src/app/page.tsx`,\n`src/components/echarts.js`).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Graph visualization\n\n**Library:** Cytoscape via `react-cytoscapejs` (`imports/cyto/graph.tsx`).\nPlugins: dagre, cola, d3-force, custom `cytoscape-deep-d3-force`, custom fork of cxtmenu\n(`imports/cyto/cxtmenu.tsx`), edge-connections, edgehandles (drag to create links).\n\n**Layouts** (`imports/cyto/layouts.tsx`, chosen in top menu, stored in local store `layout`):\n\n| Layout                    | Parameters                                                                                    |\n| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| `deep-d3-force` (default) | manyBodyStrength -2000, linkDistance 100, alpha 0.8, `infinite: true` (continuous simulation) |\n| `cola`                    | edgeLength = 100 + 10 \\* connectedEdges                                                       |\n| `dagre`                   | hierarchical                                                                                  |\n\n**Encoding a link** (`imports/cyto/elements.tsx`): every link is a node; `from`, `to` and `type`\nbecome separate edges from that node. Missing endpoints are auto-added as id-only nodes.\nLabel: `id\\ntype:Name\\nname:Name\\nvalue(11 chars + \"...\" + 9 chars)\\n\\n symbol`; symbol from the\ntype's `Symbol` link, default 📍.\n\n**Stylesheet** (`imports/cyto/stylesheets.tsx`):\n\n| Selector             | Style                             |\n| -------------------- | --------------------------------- |\n| `.link-node`         | 30x30, white, label below         |\n| `.link-from`         | edge, `tee` arrow                 |\n| `.link-to`           | edge, triangle arrow              |\n| `.link-type`         | dashed `[5,5]`, triangle arrow    |\n| `:hover`             | underlay #0080ff                  |\n| `.focused`           | border-width 4, blue.500          |\n| `.query-link-*-node` | small 8px / 16px dots             |\n| `:parent`            | compound nodes, gray, opacity 0.1 |\n\n**Interactions**\n\n- Radial context menu on node (`cxttapstart` / `taphold`), radius 108, activeFillColor\n  `rgba(0,128,255,0.75)`: editor, unlock, delete, delete down, insert, update, login, space,\n  container, traveler (n), readme. Core (background) menu: insert, center, query.\n- Double click opens the type's handler as a floating window; drag positions get saved as Focus.\n- Edgehandles: drag from a node to create a link (type picked afterwards).\n- Traveler (`imports/cyto/traveler.tsx`): per-node sub-menu toggling query links that pull in\n  neighbours: types, out, in, up, down, to, from, typed, all / by-type. A `Traveler` link points\n  to an active `Query` contained in the space.\n- Search (`MenuSearch`), \"clear focuses\", per-handler HandleCyto toggles.\n\n**Perception graph** (`perception-app/imports/graph.tsx`): declarative React components\n`<Graph>`, `<GraphNode>`, `<GraphEdge>`, `<GraphStyle>` over cytoscape, with\n`cytoscape-node-html-label` (HTML labels in nodes), cola and dagre.\n\n**Keyboard orientation** (`perception-app/imports/orientation.tsx`): `NavDirection` values\ncurrent, close, delete, edit-from, from, type, to, edit-to, out, typed, in, up, down, prev, next,\nparents, contains, insert, value, results. Each has a left/up/right/down mapping — a spatial\nkeyboard map over link relations.\n\n**3D**: aframe + aframe-forcegraph code exists but is fully commented out; 3D mode requested in\ndeepcase-app #159.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Windows / frames / tabs model\n\nAll window state is **links in the space**, so a layout is persistable and shareable:\n\n| Concept                      | Representation                                                        |\n| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Space (workspace)            | a link id in URL (`useSpaceId`), \"enter space\" via radial menu        |\n| Container (where inserts go) | link id in URL (`useContainer`)                                       |\n| Node position                | `Focus` link (space -> link), value `{x, y}`; \"unlock\" deletes it     |\n| Open window                  | `Opened` link (space -> link) from `@deep-foundation/deepcase-opened` |\n| Which handler in the window  | `OpenedHandler` link (Opened -> Handler)                              |\n| Visible neighbours           | `Traveler` -> `Query` links                                           |\n\n- API: `useOpenedMethods()` in `imports/cyto/opened.tsx` -> `open(id, handlerId)`, `close(id)`,\n  `isOpened(id)`.\n- Windows are React overlays anchored to graph nodes: `CytoReactLayout`\n  (`imports/cyto/react.tsx`) applies a CSS transform to a div synchronized with Cytoscape\n  `pan zoom`, `render`, `add`, `layoutstop`, `data`, `position bounds` events.\n- Window header (`imports/cyto/hooks.tsx` ~L640-710): handler picker popover\n  (`CytoReactLinksCard`), \"open in new full tab\" button, close button.\n- Full tab: `/client-handler?props={\"linkId\":..,\"handlerId\":..}` (deepcase-app\n  `pages/client-handler.tsx`) renders any handler as a standalone page.\n- Modal windows: editor (`CytoEditor`), packager (`PackagerInterface`: npm search + install /\n  uninstall tabs), connector (local docker/engine portal).\n- Top menu (`imports/cyto/menu.tsx`, framer-motion animated) — attached ButtonGroups:\n  `auth <id> x`, `space <id> x`, `container <id> x`, copy token / paste token / login token,\n  gql, editor; switches: autofocus, focus, opened, debug, types, traveler, breadcrumbs,\n  cytoHandlers, animation; layout select; search; clear focuses; Travelers popover; CytoHandlers\n  popover. Version text bottom-left; sun/moon toggle fixed top-right (`imports/switch-mode.tsx`).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Editors\n\n1. **Code editor modal** — `CytoEditor` (`imports/cyto/editor.tsx`, 656 lines):\n   - Tabs persisted in local store `editor-tabs` + active `editor-tab`; drafts in `editor-values`\n     (500 ms debounce). `EditorTab` = `{id, saved, active, loading, initialValue}` with unsaved dot.\n   - `EditorGrid` (`imports/editor/editor-grid.tsx`): two columns or VerticalSash split; left\n     Monaco, right switchable area (`editor-switcher.tsx`): **Preview** (runs handler on the link,\n     `fillSize` toggle), **Handlers** (which handlers bind this code), **Results** (handler/\n     promise results). Language list `editor-lang-list`, TS diagnostics options.\n2. **WYSIWYG** — `DeepWysiwyg` (`imports/deep-wysiwyg.tsx`): Slate with Mark buttons (bold,\n   italic, underline, code) and Block buttons (h1/h2, quote, numbered/bulleted list, align),\n   HTML (de)serialization via slate-serializers; `useStringSaver` writes the link's string value.\n3. **Forms** — rjsf JSON-schema forms and react-hook-form for structured values.\n4. **Graph editing** — insert / update / delete via radial menu and edgehandles.\n5. **Perception editor** — Monaco plus CodeMirror (`@uiw/react-codemirror`) for mobile.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Theming\n\n**deepcase theme** (`imports/theme/theme.tsx`): Chakra `extendTheme`, `cssVarPrefix: 'deepCase'`,\n`initialColorMode: 'light'`.\n\n| Token / color               | Light                                                 | Dark                |\n| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |\n| body bg                     | gray.100                                              | cyDark `#141214`    |\n| backgroundModal             | blue.50                                               | blue.900 `#19202B`  |\n| editorPreviewBackgroundGrid | `#e5eefc`                                             | `#404040`           |\n| primary                     | `#0080ff`                                             | `#0080ff`           |\n| text                        | grayText `#3a3a3a`                                    | whiteText `#ebf8ff` |\n| other                       | whiteBg `#fcfcfc`, gray.10 `#eee`, gray.900 `#111720` |                     |\n\nSemantic tokens: [REDACTED], borderColor, backgroundModal, buttonBackgroundModal, switchOn/Off,\neditorPreviewBackground, editorPreviewBackgroundGrid, whiteGray, bgColor, siteBg.\n\n**perception theme** (`perception-imports/imports/theme.tsx`): `initialColorMode: 'dark'`,\n`useSystemColorMode: true`; `deep` palette 50 `#EBF8FF`, 100 `#BEE3F8`, 400 `#4299E1`,\n600 `#2B6CB0`, 700 `#2C5282`, 800 `#1B2535`, 900 `#19202B`, 950 `#0000004d`; `danger` palette;\nactive `#00438F` (light) / cyan (dark); splash `#0D1117`; tokens deepBg, deepColor, deepBgHover,\ndeepBgActive, deepLine, deepLinkNodeBg; `ColorMode` button component.\n\n**deep (2025)** (`src/theme.tsx`): MUI dark, neutral primary `#cccccc`, per-value-type colors\n(value `#64B5F6`, symbol `#FFD54F`, undefined `#90A4AE`, promise `#4DB6AC`, boolean `#F06292`,\nstring `#81C784`, number `#7986CB`, bigint `#9575CD`, set `#4DD0E1`, ...), black canvas.\n\nGraph colors live separately in Cytoscape stylesheets (not in Chakra tokens) — a source of\nlight/dark bugs (see section 10).\n\n---\n\n## 7. Classic UI versions worth reproducing as themes\n\n1. **\"DeepCase classic light\" (0.1.0-beta, deepcase-app issue #76 screenshot)**\n   - Full-screen pale gray-blue canvas (`#edf2f7`-like, Chakra gray.100); hundreds of small\n     emoji nodes (⭐ Type, 📍 default, 🔥 Operation, 📎 Value, 🌲 Tree) with multi-line labels\n     `75 / type:Type / name:Schedule`; thin gray edges with arrowheads.\n   - Row 1: attached outlined button groups `auth 376 x | space 182 x | container 182 x |\ncopy token | paste token | gql | editor`; blue `packager` button top-right.\n   - Row 2: switches autofocus (on, blue), focus, debug, types, promises, traveler, breadcrumbs;\n     search input below; version `0.1.0-beta.2` bottom-left.\n2. **\"DeepCase dark + radial menu\" (issue #299)** — `#141214` canvas, selected node white circle\n   with blue ring and emoji avatar, large faded label `1044 type:User`, dark gray pie menu with\n   rotated wedge labels (editor, traveler (0), container, space, login, update, insert,\n   delete down, delete, unlock); blue active wedge.\n3. **\"DeepCase handler windows\"** — floating Chakra cards anchored to nodes, header with handler\n   picker / new tab / close; Monaco editor modal with tab strip and Preview/Handlers/Results.\n4. **\"Perception dark\"** — `deep` palette (`#19202B`/`#1B2535`), cyan active, HTML labels inside\n   nodes, keyboard-orientation navigation, slide-out auth panel, status dot.\n5. **\"deepcase.github.io landing\"** — `DeepFrame` (`imports/deep-case-frame/deep-frame.tsx`):\n   framer-motion spring tilt card (rotateX/rotateY +/-15 deg, perspective 450) with DeepCaseMini\n   inside, play button, toggler; flying words, typist effect.\n6. **\"Deep 2025 echarts\"** — black canvas, MUI dark, nodes colored by JS value type.\n7. **\"RTS / game mode\"** (deepcase-app #116, #112, #114) — UI \"inspired by RTS games\",\n   edge-scrolling, keyboard scroll, fullscreen; must be switchable back to \"boring\".\n8. **\"3D / VR force graph\"** (#159, commented-out aframe-forcegraph code).\n\nEach can be captured as a nested Links Notation theme: tokens (colors), graph style rules\n(selector -> properties), chrome layout (which menus/rows/switches exist), interaction profile\n(radial vs linear menu, mouse vs keyboard).\n\n---\n\n## 8. Patterns worth adopting (concrete)\n\n1. **Type-bound renderers as links**: `HandleClient(Type -> Handler)`; renderer lookup is a\n   query, so adding a renderer never touches the shell.\n2. **Context-sensitive handler selection** via `Context` links (same link, different view per\n   context: graph node, window, full tab, list row).\n3. **Separate visual-in-graph handlers** (`HandleCyto`) from content handlers — two binding kinds:\n   \"how it looks as a node\" vs \"how it looks when opened\".\n4. **Window state as links**: `Opened(space -> link)` + `OpenedHandler(opened -> handler)`.\n5. **Positions as links**: `Focus(space -> link) = {x, y}` — layout is data; unlock = delete.\n6. **Workspace = link** (space) and **insertion target = link** (container), both in the URL.\n7. **Traveler**: neighbourhood expansion as stored, toggleable queries (types/in/out/up/down/...).\n8. **Overlay sync**: HTML windows positioned by graph pan/zoom transform (`CytoReactLayout`).\n9. **Declarative graph DSL** (`<Graph><GraphNode/><GraphEdge/><GraphStyle/></Graph>`) — maps\n   1:1 to nested Links Notation.\n10. **Keyboard orientation map**: relation -> arrow-key direction table (`orientation.tsx`).\n11. **One store API, three backends** (URL / local / cookie) — shareable vs private state.\n12. **Semantic tokens with light/dark values** (Chakra semantic tokens, `cssVarPrefix`).\n13. **Require whitelist** for user code and lazy dependency resolution.\n14. **Error boundary per handler** with reset and source/dist view.\n15. **Layout picker** with layout parameters as data (force, cola, dagre).\n16. **Full-tab URL for any (link, handler) pair** — deep linking into any view.\n17. **Editor = tabs + code + Preview/Handlers/Results**; drafts autosaved with debounce.\n18. **WYSIWYG for string values** with HTML serialization.\n19. **App shell itself as a handler** (perception `Layout` link with Auth/Status/ColorMode slots).\n20. **Per-value-type color palette** (deep 2025) as a theme dimension.\n21. **Link label template** (`id / type / name / value / symbol`) and **type Symbol** (emoji\n    icon per type) as default node rendering.\n22. **Radial context menu** for link operations; linear alternative for readability (#299).\n\n---\n\n## 9. Problems, bugs, limitations\n\nIssue numbers: `#N` up to #85 without prefix = [deepcase issues](https://github.com/deep-foundation/deepcase/issues);\nnumbers marked \"deepcase-app\" or above #85 = [deepcase-app issues](https://github.com/deep-foundation/deepcase-app/issues).\n\n**Architectural**\n\n- `eval` of TSX strings: no sandbox, full DOM/network access; whitelist only limits `require`\n  (deepcase #85 proposes renaming to \"unsafe\" handlers and adding safe ones).\n- Handlers tied to React + Chakra + browser; no React Native / Swift / Kotlin path.\n- Handler dependency resolution and paths (#60, #63, #64 `import.meta`), MUI in handlers (#72/#74).\n- Graph styles live in Cytoscape stylesheets, outside theme tokens -> dark/light mismatches\n  (#22 icons disappear in dark mode; deepcase-app #234/#80/#296 light-theme readability).\n- No label LOD: tiny/overlapping text is rendered (#37, #47); no pagination (#36).\n- Performance: too many re-renders (#65), slow/crashes after 24 h (#24), freezes/white screen\n  (deepcase-app #226/#123), iPadOS nodes disappear (#235), edges disappear when moving (#320).\n\n**Layout**\n\n- d3-force with `infinite: true` is unstable and wanders (#51, #52, deepcase-app #269/#218/#191);\n  cola cannot accept positions (#27); auto-place over the whole screen requested (#56);\n  Any-Any link treated as node (#28).\n\n**Windows**\n\n- deepcase-app: z-index of handler window over modal (deepcase-app #290); handler not fully visible in preview\n  (#297), handler not reopened / freeze with duplicate handlers (#282/#281); deepcase: handler\n  link floats (#53), double click opens twice (#30); remember last opened handler (#292); draggable\n  widget header requested (#198).\n\n**Editor**\n\n- State/tab bugs (deepcase-app #243, #238, #231, #178, #171, #170, #138, #137, #240), random\n  links opened (#45), splitter not remembered (#54), code lost when switching tabs (#43),\n  links unsorted (#84), no warn-before-update (#44), cannot set empty string (#35), clicking a\n  code file runs it (#3).\n\n**UX**\n\n- deepcase-app: rotated radial menu text unreadable (#299); browser context menu conflicts (#57/#87/#95);\n  search case / trailing space bugs (#110/#99/#245); drag & drop broken (#293).\n- Requested: user-configurable themes (#300, #247) and backgrounds/animated handlers (#301),\n  multilingual UI (#274), linear.app-style keyboard (#228), graph aggregation / filters / time\n  sort / PNG-PDF export (#89, Linkurious/Ogma references), and in deepcase zoom-into-space (#82),\n  return to last space (#83), pinning (#41), graphical undo/snapshots (#8), 3D (#159), voice/sounds (#155-#158).\n- Build/OS: Vite/bun (#9/#10), many build/OS issues (deepcase-app #31-#41).\n\n---\n\n## 11. Migration notes for link-foundation/ui\n\n1. **Replace eval'd TSX with Links Notation component trees.** A handler becomes a LiNo tree\n   (element / props / children / bindings) interpreted by per-platform renderers (DOM, React,\n   React Native, Vue, SwiftUI, Compose). Architecture: links-as-UI and client handlers\n\n### 2.1 UI stored as links\n\nA UI component is a **code link** plus **binding links**:\n\n```\n(handler: Handler clientSupportsJs -> tsxCodeLink)      # \"this code runs in the browser\"\n(handleClient: HandleClient SomeType -> handler)        # \"render links of SomeType with it\"\n```\n\n- The code link (type `TSX`, `@deep-foundation/core`) holds a string value of the form\n  `({deep, require}) => { const React = require('react'); ... return Component }`.\n- `deep._findHandler({ handlerId, context })` (deeplinks `imports/client.tsx` ~L2277) queries the\n  `handlers` table filtered by the JS execution provider. Without `handlerId` it matches a\n  `@deep-foundation/deepcase` `Context` link among the context ids — i.e. handler choice is\n  context-sensitive and itself a link query.\n- `evalClientHandler` (deeplinks `imports/client-handler.tsx`) runs `eval(value)`, expects a\n  function, calls it with `{deep, gql, require, ...input}`, and renders the returned component.\n- `require` is a **whitelist map** (`r.list` in deepcase `imports/client-handler.tsx`) of\n  packages: react, chakra, framer-motion, monaco, cytoscape, recharts, d3, etc. Heavier modules\n  are resolved lazily through `DeepClient.resolveDependency`.\n- `CatchErrors` is an error boundary that renders a Chakra `Alert` with a reset button.\n  Perception replaces it with `ClientHandlerErrorComponent` (modal, src/dist toggle, FinderButton).\n- `ClientHandlerRenderer` props: `fillSize`, `onClose`, `linkId`, `handlerId`, `context`.\n\n### 2.2 Package-defined handlers (`deep.json` of deepcase)\n\n| Handler                  | Bound to types                       |\n| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |\n| `asyncFileClientHandler` | AsyncFile (image/video/file preview) |\n| `stringClientHandler`    | Join, PackageQuery, Contain          |\n| `queryClientHandler`     | Query                                |\n| `editorClientHandler`    | SyncTextFile, TSX                    |\n\nOther types declared: `Traveler` (Any -> Query, symbol 🧳), `ContextToken`, `Context`.\n\n### 2.3 HandleCyto — graph rendering as links\n\n`@deep-foundation/handle-cyto` defines `HandleCyto`: a handler that returns Cytoscape `elements`\nand `stylesheets` for links of a given type (`imports/cyto-handler.tsx`). Example:\n`HandleCytoContainInvisible` hides Contain edges. Rules can be toggled per handler\n(`useCytoHandlersRules`). So **per-type visual representation is data**, not code in the shell.\n\n### 2.4 State stores\n\n`@deep-foundation/store` provides one hook API over three backends:\n`useQueryStore` (URL query, shareable), `useLocalStore` (localStorage), `useCookiesStore`.\nExamples: `useSpaceId`, `useContainer` (query store); `layout`, `editor-tabs` (local store).\n\n### 2.5 Perception (second generation)\n\n- `perception-imports/imports/go.tsx` (927 lines): `GoI`, `GoProvider`, `useGo` — navigation as a\n  chainable cursor (`go.focus`, `go.do`, `go.parents`) with `History` / `HistoryHandler` links.\n- `perception-imports/imports/react-handler.tsx`: `ReactHandler`, `ReactHandlersProvider`,\n  `createComponent` — handlers usable as plain React components.\n- `perception-app/pages/index.tsx`: the **whole app shell is a handler** —\n  `<go.Handler handlerId={deep.idLocal('@deep-foundation/perception-links','Layout')} Auth={...} Status={...} ColorMode={...}/>`.\n  The shell supplies only slot components (auth slide-out panel, status indicator, color mode).\n- Also: Telegram web-app script, regenerable `preloaded.json` (handlers bundled offline).\n\n### 2.6 The 2025 rewrite (`deep-foundation/deep`)\n\nNext 15 app router, MUI 6 dark theme (`src/theme.tsx`) with a **per-JS-value-type palette**\n(`types.value/symbol/undefined/promise/boolean/string/number/bigint/set/weakSet...`, each with\nmain/light/dark), black canvas page rendering an echarts graph (`src/app/page.tsx`,\n`src/components/echarts.js`).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Graph visualization\n\n**Library:** Cytoscape via `react-cytoscapejs` (`imports/cyto/graph.tsx`).\nPlugins: dagre, cola, d3-force, custom `cytoscape-deep-d3-force`, custom fork of cxtmenu\n(`imports/cyto/cxtmenu.tsx`), edge-connections, edgehandles (drag to create links).\n\n**Layouts** (`imports/cyto/layouts.tsx`, chosen in top menu, stored in local store `layout`):\n\n| Layout                    | Parameters                                                                                    |\n| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| `deep-d3-force` (default) | manyBodyStrength -2000, linkDistance 100, alpha 0.8, `infinite: true` (continuous simulation) |\n| `cola`                    | edgeLength = 100 + 10 \\* connectedEdges                                                       |\n| `dagre`                   | hierarchical                                                                                  |\n\n**Encoding a link** (`imports/cyto/elements.tsx`): every link is a node; `from`, `to` and `type`\nbecome separate edges from that node. Missing endpoints are auto-added as id-only nodes.\nLabel: `id\\ntype:Name\\nname:Name\\nvalue(11 chars + \"...\" + 9 chars)\\n\\n symbol`; symbol from the\ntype's `Symbol` link, default 📍.\n\n**Stylesheet** (`imports/cyto/stylesheets.tsx`):\n\n| Selector             | Style                             |\n| -------------------- | --------------------------------- |\n| `.link-node`         | 30x30, white, label below         |\n| `.link-from`         | edge, `tee` arrow                 |\n| `.link-to`           | edge, triangle arrow              |\n| `.link-type`         | dashed `[5,5]`, triangle arrow    |\n| `:hover`             | underlay #0080ff                  |\n| `.focused`           | border-width 4, blue.500          |\n| `.query-link-*-node` | small 8px / 16px dots             |\n| `:parent`            | compound nodes, gray, opacity 0.1 |\n\n**Interactions**\n\n- Radial context menu on node (`cxttapstart` / `taphold`), radius 108, activeFillColor\n  `rgba(0,128,255,0.75)`: editor, unlock, delete, delete down, insert, update, login, space,\n  container, traveler (n), readme. Core (background) menu: insert, center, query.\n- Double click opens the type's handler as a floating window; drag positions get saved as Focus.\n- Edgehandles: drag from a node to create a link (type picked afterwards).\n- Traveler (`imports/cyto/traveler.tsx`): per-node sub-menu toggling query links that pull in\n  neighbours: types, out, in, up, down, to, from, typed, all / by-type. A `Traveler` link points\n  to an active `Query` contained in the space.\n- Search (`MenuSearch`), \"clear focuses\", per-handler HandleCyto toggles.\n\n**Perception graph** (`perception-app/imports/graph.tsx`): declarative React components\n`<Graph>`, `<GraphNode>`, `<GraphEdge>`, `<GraphStyle>` over cytoscape, with\n`cytoscape-node-html-label` (HTML labels in nodes), cola and dagre.\n\n**Keyboard orientation** (`perception-app/imports/orientation.tsx`): `NavDirection` values\ncurrent, close, delete, edit-from, from, type, to, edit-to, out, typed, in, up, down, prev, next,\nparents, contains, insert, value, results. Each has a left/up/right/down mapping — a spatial\nkeyboard map over link relations.\n\n**3D**: aframe + aframe-forcegraph code exists but is fully commented out; 3D mode requested in\ndeepcase-app #159.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Windows / frames / tabs model\n\nAll window state is **links in the space**, so a layout is persistable and shareable:\n\n| Concept                      | Representation                                                        |\n| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Space (workspace)            | a link id in URL (`useSpaceId`), \"enter space\" via radial menu        |\n| Container (where inserts go) | link id in URL (`useContainer`)                                       |\n| Node position                | `Focus` link (space -> link), value `{x, y}`; \"unlock\" deletes it     |\n| Open window                  | `Opened` link (space -> link) from `@deep-foundation/deepcase-opened` |\n| Which handler in the window  | `OpenedHandler` link (Opened -> Handler)                              |\n| Visible neighbours           | `Traveler` -> `Query` links                                           |\n\n- API: `useOpenedMethods()` in `imports/cyto/opened.tsx` -> `open(id, handlerId)`, `close(id)`,\n  `isOpened(id)`.\n- Windows are React overlays anchored to graph nodes: `CytoReactLayout`\n  (`imports/cyto/react.tsx`) applies a CSS transform to a div synchronized with Cytoscape\n  `pan zoom`, `render`, `add`, `layoutstop`, `data`, `position bounds` events.\n- Window header (`imports/cyto/hooks.tsx` ~L640-710): handler picker popover\n  (`CytoReactLinksCard`), \"open in new full tab\" button, close button.\n- Full tab: `/client-handler?props={\"linkId\":..,\"handlerId\":..}` (deepcase-app\n  `pages/client-handler.tsx`) renders any handler as a standalone page.\n- Modal windows: editor (`CytoEditor`), packager (`PackagerInterface`: npm search + install /\n  uninstall tabs), connector (local docker/engine portal).\n- Top menu (`imports/cyto/menu.tsx`, framer-motion animated) — attached ButtonGroups:\n  `auth <id> x`, `space <id> x`, `container <id> x`, copy token / paste token / login token,\n  gql, editor; switches: autofocus, focus, opened, debug, types, traveler, breadcrumbs,\n  cytoHandlers, animation; layout select; search; clear focuses; Travelers popover; CytoHandlers\n  popover. Version text bottom-left; sun/moon toggle fixed top-right (`imports/switch-mode.tsx`).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Editors\n\n1. **Code editor modal** — `CytoEditor` (`imports/cyto/editor.tsx`, 656 lines):\n   - Tabs persisted in local store `editor-tabs` + active `editor-tab`; drafts in `editor-values`\n     (500 ms debounce). `EditorTab` = `{id, saved, active, loading, initialValue}` with unsaved dot.\n   - `EditorGrid` (`imports/editor/editor-grid.tsx`): two columns or VerticalSash split; left\n     Monaco, right switchable area (`editor-switcher.tsx`): **Preview** (runs handler on the link,\n     `fillSize` toggle), **Handlers** (which handlers bind this code), **Results** (handler/\n     promise results). Language list `editor-lang-list`, TS diagnostics options.\n2. **WYSIWYG** — `DeepWysiwyg` (`imports/deep-wysiwyg.tsx`): Slate with Mark buttons (bold,\n   italic, underline, code) and Block buttons (h1/h2, quote, numbered/bulleted list, align),\n   HTML (de)serialization via slate-serializers; `useStringSaver` writes the link's string value.\n3. **Forms** — rjsf JSON-schema forms and react-hook-form for structured values.\n4. **Graph editing** — insert / update / delete via radial menu and edgehandles.\n5. **Perception editor** — Monaco plus CodeMirror (`@uiw/react-codemirror`) for mobile.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Theming\n\n**deepcase theme** (`imports/theme/theme.tsx`): Chakra `extendTheme`, `cssVarPrefix: 'deepCase'`,\n`initialColorMode: 'light'`.\n\n| Token / color               | Light                                                 | Dark                |\n| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |\n| body bg                     | gray.100                                              | cyDark `#141214`    |\n| backgroundModal             | blue.50                                               | blue.900 `#19202B`  |\n| editorPreviewBackgroundGrid | `#e5eefc`                                             | `#404040`           |\n| primary                     | `#0080ff`                                             | `#0080ff`           |\n| text                        | grayText `#3a3a3a`                                    | whiteText `#ebf8ff` |\n| other                       | whiteBg `#fcfcfc`, gray.10 `#eee`, gray.900 `#111720` |                     |\n\nSemantic tokens: [REDACTED], borderColor, backgroundModal, buttonBackgroundModal, switchOn/Off,\neditorPreviewBackground, editorPreviewBackgroundGrid, whiteGray, bgColor, siteBg.\n\n**perception theme** (`perception-imports/imports/theme.tsx`): `initialColorMode: 'dark'`,\n`useSystemColorMode: true`; `deep` palette 50 `#EBF8FF`, 100 `#BEE3F8`, 400 `#4299E1`,\n600 `#2B6CB0`, 700 `#2C5282`, 800 `#1B2535`, 900 `#19202B`, 950 `#0000004d`; `danger` palette;\nactive `#00438F` (light) / cyan (dark); splash `#0D1117`; tokens deepBg, deepColor, deepBgHover,\ndeepBgActive, deepLine, deepLinkNodeBg; `ColorMode` button component.\n\n**deep (2025)** (`src/theme.tsx`): MUI dark, neutral primary `#cccccc`, per-value-type colors\n(value `#64B5F6`, symbol `#FFD54F`, undefined `#90A4AE`, promise `#4DB6AC`, boolean `#F06292`,\nstring `#81C784`, number `#7986CB`, bigint `#9575CD`, set `#4DD0E1`, ...), black canvas.\n\nGraph colors live separately in Cytoscape stylesheets (not in Chakra tokens) — a source of\nlight/dark bugs (see section 10).\n\n---\n\n## 7. Classic UI versions worth reproducing as themes\n\n1. **\"DeepCase classic light\" (0.1.0-beta, deepcase-app issue #76 screenshot)**\n   - Full-screen pale gray-blue canvas (`#edf2f7`-like, Chakra gray.100); hundreds of small\n     emoji nodes (⭐ Type, 📍 default, 🔥 Operation, 📎 Value, 🌲 Tree) with multi-line labels\n     `75 / type:Type / name:Schedule`; thin gray edges with arrowheads.\n   - Row 1: attached outlined button groups `auth 376 x | space 182 x | container 182 x |\ncopy token | paste token | gql | editor`; blue `packager` button top-right.\n   - Row 2: switches autofocus (on, blue), focus, debug, types, promises, traveler, breadcrumbs;\n     search input below; version `0.1.0-beta.2` bottom-left.\n2. **\"DeepCase dark + radial menu\" (issue #299)** — `#141214` canvas, selected node white circle\n   with blue ring and emoji avatar, large faded label `1044 type:User`, dark gray pie menu with\n   rotated wedge labels (editor, traveler (0), container, space, login, update, insert,\n   delete down, delete, unlock); blue active wedge.\n3. **\"DeepCase handler windows\"** — floating Chakra cards anchored to nodes, header with handler\n   picker / new tab / close; Monaco editor modal with tab strip and Preview/Handlers/Results.\n4. **\"Perception dark\"** — `deep` palette (`#19202B`/`#1B2535`), cyan active, HTML labels inside\n   nodes, keyboard-orientation navigation, slide-out auth panel, status dot.\n5. **\"deepcase.github.io landing\"** — `DeepFrame` (`imports/deep-case-frame/deep-frame.tsx`):\n   framer-motion spring tilt card (rotateX/rotateY +/-15 deg, perspective 450) with DeepCaseMini\n   inside, play button, toggler; flying words, typist effect.\n6. **\"Deep 2025 echarts\"** — black canvas, MUI dark, nodes colored by JS value type.\n7. **\"RTS / game mode\"** (deepcase-app #116, #112, #114) — UI \"inspired by RTS games\",\n   edge-scrolling, keyboard scroll, fullscreen; must be switchable back to \"boring\".\n8. **\"3D / VR force graph\"** (#159, commented-out aframe-forcegraph code).\n\nEach can be captured as a nested Links Notation theme: tokens (colors), graph style rules\n(selector -> properties), chrome layout (which menus/rows/switches exist), interaction profile\n(radial vs linear menu, mouse vs keyboard).\n\n---\n\n## 8. Patterns worth adopting (concrete)\n\n1. **Type-bound renderers as links**: `HandleClient(Type -> Handler)`; renderer lookup is a\n   query, so adding a renderer never touches the shell.\n2. **Context-sensitive handler selection** via `Context` links (same link, different view per\n   context: graph node, window, full tab, list row).\n3. **Separate visual-in-graph handlers** (`HandleCyto`) from content handlers — two binding kinds:\n   \"how it looks as a node\" vs \"how it looks when opened\".\n4. **Window state as links**: `Opened(space -> link)` + `OpenedHandler(opened -> handler)`.\n5. **Positions as links**: `Focus(space -> link) = {x, y}` — layout is data; unlock = delete.\n6. **Workspace = link** (space) and **insertion target = link** (container), both in the URL.\n7. **Traveler**: neighbourhood expansion as stored, toggleable queries (types/in/out/up/down/...).\n8. **Overlay sync**: HTML windows positioned by graph pan/zoom transform (`CytoReactLayout`).\n9. **Declarative graph DSL** (`<Graph><GraphNode/><GraphEdge/><GraphStyle/></Graph>`) — maps\n   1:1 to nested Links Notation.\n10. **Keyboard orientation map**: relation -> arrow-key direction table (`orientation.tsx`).\n11. **One store API, three backends** (URL / local / cookie) — shareable vs private state.\n12. **Semantic tokens with light/dark values** (Chakra semantic tokens, `cssVarPrefix`).\n13. **Require whitelist** for user code and lazy dependency resolution.\n14. **Error boundary per handler** with reset and source/dist view.\n15. **Layout picker** with layout parameters as data (force, cola, dagre).\n16. **Full-tab URL for any (link, handler) pair** — deep linking into any view.\n17. **Editor = tabs + code + Preview/Handlers/Results**; drafts autosaved with debounce.\n18. **WYSIWYG for string values** with HTML serialization.\n19. **App shell itself as a handler** (perception `Layout` link with Auth/Status/ColorMode slots).\n20. **Per-value-type color palette** (deep 2025) as a theme dimension.\n21. **Link label template** (`id / type / name / value / symbol`) and **type Symbol** (emoji\n    icon per type) as default node rendering.\n22. **Radial context menu** for link operations; linear alternative for readability (#299).\n\n---\n\n## 9. Problems, bugs, limitations\n\nIssue numbers: `#N` up to #85 without prefix = [deepcase issues](https://github.com/deep-foundation/deepcase/issues);\nnumbers marked \"deepcase-app\" or above #85 = [deepcase-app issues](https://github.com/deep-foundation/deepcase-app/issues).\n\n**Architectural**\n\n- `eval` of TSX strings: no sandbox, full DOM/network access; whitelist only limits `require`\n  (deepcase #85 proposes renaming to \"unsafe\" handlers and adding safe ones).\n- Handlers tied to React + Chakra + browser; no React Native / Swift / Kotlin path.\n- Handler dependency resolution and paths (#60, #63, #64 `import.meta`), MUI in handlers (#72/#74).\n- Graph styles live in Cytoscape stylesheets, outside theme tokens -> dark/light mismatches\n  (#22 icons disappear in dark mode; deepcase-app #234/#80/#296 light-theme readability).\n- No label LOD: tiny/overlapping text is rendered (#37, #47); no pagination (#36).\n- Performance: too many re-renders (#65), slow/crashes after 24 h (#24), freezes/white screen\n  (deepcase-app #226/#123), iPadOS nodes disappear (#235), edges disappear when moving (#320).\n\n**Layout**\n\n- d3-force with `infinite: true` is unstable and wanders (#51, #52, deepcase-app #269/#218/#191);\n  cola cannot accept positions (#27); auto-place over the whole screen requested (#56);\n  Any-Any link treated as node (#28).\n\n**Windows**\n\n- deepcase-app: z-index of handler window over modal (deepcase-app #290); handler not fully visible in preview\n  (#297), handler not reopened / freeze with duplicate handlers (#282/#281); deepcase: handler\n  link floats (#53), double click opens twice (#30); remember last opened handler (#292); draggable\n  widget header requested (#198).\n\n**Editor**\n\n- State/tab bugs (deepcase-app #243, #238, #231, #178, #171, #170, #138, #137, #240), random\n  links opened (#45), splitter not remembered (#54), code lost when switching tabs (#43),\n  links unsorted (#84), no warn-before-update (#44), cannot set empty string (#35), clicking a\n  code file runs it (#3).\n\n**UX**\n\n- deepcase-app: rotated radial menu text unreadable (#299); browser context menu conflicts (#57/#87/#95);\n  search case / trailing space bugs (#110/#99/#245); drag & drop broken (#293).\n- Requested: user-configurable themes (#300, #247) and backgrounds/animated handlers (#301),\n  multilingual UI (#274), linear.app-style keyboard (#228), graph aggregation / filters / time\n  sort / PNG-PDF export (#89, Linkurious/Ogma references), and in deepcase zoom-into-space (#82),\n  return to last space (#83), pinning (#41), graphical undo/snapshots (#8), 3D (#159), voice/sounds (#155-#158).\n- Build/OS: Vite/bun (#9/#10), many build/OS issues (deepcase-app #31-#41).\n\n---\n\n## 11. Migration notes for link-foundation/ui\n\n1. **Replace eval'd TSX with Links Notation component trees.** A handler becomes a LiNo tree\n   (element / props / children / bindings) interpreted by per-platform renderers (DOM, React,\n   React Native, Vue, SwiftUI, Compose). This avoids a flash of the wrong theme or skin, and it is the same code as at runtime, not a copy.\n6. **Store.**\n   - [K:src/settings/store.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/store.js)\n     is built on `useSyncExternalStore`. It has no context provider.\n   - **Only the diff from defaults** is stored, in localStorage `settings`. Users who never touched a key\n     therefore get improved defaults automatically.\n   - Other tabs stay in sync through the `storage` event.\n   - API: `setSettings(patch)`, `resetSettings(keys)`, `changesOf`.\n7. **Looks (presets).** Defined in [K:src/settings/presets.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/presets.js).\n   - Built-in presets: Matrix universe (default), glass-universe, calm, matrix, deep-space, warp,\n     neon (Tron), liquid, blueprint, and \"Light and fast\" for slow phones.\n   - `before45()` rebases old presets onto `PREVIOUS_DEFAULTS`.\n   - `COMFORT` lists keys that presets, shared links and Random never change:\n     `motion.mode`, `sound.on`, `sound.volume`, `theory.notation`, `ui.transparency`. These are\n     accessibility and preference keys; the idea comes from immortality's `src/settings.ts`.\n   - `randomLook()` never goes above the default cost on any heavy key (counts, fps, blur, glow).\n   - Saved looks are stored as `[{name, look}]` under `settings-presets`, with add, remove, import and rename.\n   - Sharing: `#settings=<urlencoded JSON>` (`shareLink`, `lookOfHash`). When a shared link is opened,\n     `openSharedLook()` applies it, saves the previous look as a \"Before the link\" preset, and strips the hash.\n8. **Preferences outside the schema.** [K:src/i18n/prefs.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/i18n/prefs.js)\n   - Language is resolved as `?lang`, then the stored value, then `navigator`, then `en`.\n   - Theme is auto/light/dark.\n   - Each is a tiny external store.\n   - All UI text is written inline as `{en, ru}` objects, and `plural.js` handles Russian plural forms.\n9. **The network editor's local style model.** [K:src/links/style.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/links/style.js)\n   - `STYLE_SECTIONS` reuses the same field factories.\n   - `normalizeStyle` validates; `styleToParams` and `styleFromParams` put **only non-default values in the\n     query string**.\n   - There are six link palettes: site, neon, pastel, warm, cold, print.\n   - The network uses the same configuration grammar as the site settings, but it is scoped to a document\n     (the URL) instead of the user (localStorage).\n10. **Settings page as live designer.** [K:src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx)\n    - The page is generated from the schema. Each row is `label | control | value | ↺ reset`, and changed\n      rows get an `is-changed` class.\n    - Layer tabs show a dot when that layer is active.\n    - There is a Reset button per section plus \"Reset everything\".\n    - \"Look at the background\" is a peek mode that hides the panels.\n    - The \"Your changes\" box shows the diff JSON with Copy, and has a paste area that loads either settings\n      or `{presets:[...]}`.\n    - Sounds have ▶ preview buttons.\n    - The page itself is the preview: it includes `InterfacePreview`, `UiSamples` (small samples of every UI\n      element, from #45), `MaterialPresets` and `CornerTiles`.\n    - Columns are explicit because CSS multicol was buggy in Safari.\n    - This is the closest existing thing to the \"VS-designer configuration mode\" the issue asks for, though\n      it edits global tokens, not per-element instances.\n11. **Testing every setting.** Issue #15 asked for proof that every setting is applied.\n    [K:src/settings/applied.test.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/applied.test.js)\n    goes through every field in `FIELDS` and fails if a setting is used in none of three ways: as a CSS\n    variable or `<html>` attribute that a stylesheet reads, as an option a background script reads, or as a\n    key a component reads.\n12. **Skins and frames.**\n    - [K:src/skins.frames.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/skins.frames.js)\n      defines corner shapes and corner lines once:\n      - shapes: square, cut, tall, wide, round, scoop, notch\n      - lines: none, gap, line, accent, bracket\n    - `npm run build:frames` generates `skins.frames.css` from it, and the same definitions draw the\n      `CornerTiles` previews. A test keeps the generated CSS in sync.\n    - The CSS uses `@property` typed lengths and `:where()` to keep specificity at zero.\n    - `schema.skins.js` has 12 palettes (from immortality) and the skins `glass`, `liquid`, `futuristic`.\n    - Owner requirements from issues:\n      - #39: a single transparency setting for all backgrounds; matte, glossy and liquid glass presets; no\n        rounded corners in the futuristic look by default; rounded corners following t3code practice\n      - #45: one per-side border configuration shared by panels, blocks, buttons and other elements; top\n        highlight width set separately from corner/side widths; the corner layer above or below content;\n        colours picked from palettes\n\n---\n\n## 5. Patterns worth adopting\n\n1. **One rule table per key**: `{default, min, max, unit, options, isColor}`. It drives normalization,\n   validation, the generated UI, CSS projection and tests. It translates naturally into a Links Notation\n   schema, e.g. `(liquid.blur: range 18 0 40 px)`.\n2. **Store the diff from defaults, never the full state.** Defaults can then improve for everyone, and saved\n   looks and share links stay small.\n3. **Project settings into CSS variables and `data-*` attributes on the root.** Theming then works without\n   any framework, and the same tokens can be emitted for SwiftUI and Compose as constant tables.\n4. **Run the same `normalize` and `apply` before first paint**, serialized from the real functions rather\n   than copied. There is no theme flash and no second implementation.\n5. **Comfort keys.** Accessibility and preference keys (reduced motion, sound, volume, transparency,\n   notation) are excluded from presets, shared links and randomization.\n6. **Looks as data.** Built-in presets, saved presets, import/export JSON, `#settings=` share links, and an\n   automatic \"Before the link\" backup when a shared look is applied.\n7. **Bounded randomization.** `randomLook()` never exceeds the default cost on heavy keys, so Random is safe\n   on slow devices. There is also an explicit \"Light and fast\" preset.\n8. **The settings page is the live preview.** Each row has a per-field ↺ reset and changed rows are marked.\n   There are section resets, a peek mode, a diff box with copy and paste, and sample tiles of every UI\n   element. Extending this to per-element editing gives the WYSIWYG configuration mode.\n9. **One source generates both CSS and preview tiles** (`skins.frames.js`), and a test fails if the\n   generated CSS is out of date.\n10. **One renderer for preview and export.** A single SVG string (`networkSvg`) is reused for PNG, JPEG and\n    WebP export, so what is shared is exactly what is seen. The same idea fits animation recording: record\n    the frames of the model, not screenshots.\n11. **URL state holds only non-default parameters** (`styleToParams`), with debounced history that pauses\n    while a slider is dragged.\n12. **Several synchronized notations of one model**, with typed-text preservation and bilingual errors. This\n    shows the framework's \"DOM-like language and Links Notation as two views of one tree\" in miniature.\n13. **Expensive layout in a cancellable worker**, with keyed results that cannot overwrite newer state\n    (`solver-job.js`, `useCollisionSolver.js`).\n14. **Performance governors.** The FPS governor degrades resolution and then fps, and `panelVisibility.js`\n    limits live `backdrop-filter` surfaces. Both belong in the framework runtime.\n15. **Owned, ARIA-compliant controls.** Select follows the APG patterns, numeric keys are shared, and popups\n    are portaled and clamped to the viewport. #39 says \"all UI elements must be owned by us\".\n16. **Declarative sound.** A `data-sound` attribute on any element plus document-level role mapping, so\n    components do not hard-code audio.\n17. **Language and theme stores built on `useSyncExternalStore`, with no provider.** This ports cleanly to\n    signals or observables in Vue, Swift and Kotlin.\n18. **Pointer-centred zoom with document-level listeners** and an infinite pattern grid (links-visuals #15,\n    #19, #21). These are designer-canvas basics.\n19. **Arc-length center anchors for links that point at links.** An anchor is pinned and re-resolved at\n    render time (`applyCenterAnchors`), which is the core of drawing associative links, not just node graphs.\n20. **Pure geometry and IK separated from rendering** (`ik-pure.mjs`), so they can be unit-tested and ported\n    to Swift and Kotlin.\n21. **A test suite per issue** (`*-NN.test.js`, `experiments/issue-N-browser.mjs` on three browser engines),\n    a case study per issue, and a hard 1500-line file limit.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Problems, bugs and limitations observed\n\n### konard.github.io\n\n1. **No license.** The code cannot legally be copied into a public-domain framework until it is relicensed\n   (for example to Unlicense, like links-visuals and immortality).\n2. **Links Notation is hand-parsed.** `parseLinks` in `edit.js` uses the regex\n   `/\\(\\s*(?:(\\d+)\\s*:)?\\s*(\\d+)[\\s,]+(\\d+)\\s*\\)/g`, and `links-notation` is not imported anywhere in `src/`.\n   It only accepts numeric doublets and does not handle nesting, names or multi-line input.\n3. **Settings are JSON, not Links Notation.** This applies to localStorage, the `#settings=` hash, the\n   diff box, and import/export. It contradicts the framework goal of representing everything in Links\n   Notation.\n4. **Bilingual text is hard-coded** as `{en, ru}` objects inside components, including long templated\n   sentences in `NetworkEditor.jsx`. Adding a language means editing every component; there is no catalog.\n5. **Configuration is global only.** The tokens style every element of a kind. There is no per-instance\n   override and no element tree to select from, so it is not yet a WYSIWYG designer.\n6. **React-bound.** The store, pages and controls are React components; only `apply.js` and `src/links/*`\n   are framework-free.\n7. **Open issue #47.** The top-left corner and the top and bottom edges are not transparent by default,\n   although every other element is. These are still border/corner layering bugs from the #45 redesign.\n8. **Fixed bugs worth remembering.**\n   - #13: the rain sometimes scaled up too much on refresh.\n   - #45: some border configurations clipped overflowing content or broke transparent backgrounds and\n     selection.\n   - CSS multicol was unreliable in Safari, so columns are explicit.\n   - Safari needed a focus fix in `numericKeys.js`.\n9. **Heavy generated CSS.** `skins.frames.css` is about 84 KB / 1067 lines, and a very large number of\n   fields (hundreds) costs payload and maintenance.\n10. **Repo weight.** About 372 MB, from case studies, logs and archives committed to the repo, so it is\n    slow to clone. Sparse clones are needed.\n11. **Migrations are ad hoc** (`before45()`, special cases in `normalize`). There is no versioned schema\n    migration mechanism.\n\n### links-visuals\n\n1. **CDN at runtime.** D3 is fetched from `esm.sh/use-m` on every load. It does not work offline, it is\n   unpinned and therefore a supply-chain risk, and it is not reproducible.\n2. **Global mutable state** in `state.mjs` (module singletons with setters). Two views cannot share a page.\n3. **Duplicated renderers.** `canvas-render.mjs` re-implements the SVG markers and paths by hand, and the\n   two can drift apart.\n4. **A rAF loop runs every frame even when idle** (`animation.mjs`), which wastes battery.\n5. **Inline CSS is copied into every HTML page**, with no theming. Markers are hardcoded black, and only\n   grid.html and draw.html have colour.\n6. **Experiments are not composable.** Each page wires modules differently, and `failed-attempts/` holds 76\n   HTML snapshots instead of git history.\n7. **Limits of the network model.** grid.html places links in cells without real references. Only draw.html\n   has link-to-link anchors, and only to centers (no source/target-to-endpoint semantics, no layout engine).\n8. **Fixed bugs worth remembering.**\n   - #1/#3: start-point snapping.\n   - #15: the grid was not infinite.\n   - #19/#21: zoom failed away from the center because the hit area was the SVG; listeners were moved to\n     `document`.\n   - #23/#28: grid proportions were inconsistent with single-link mode.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Migration notes for link-foundation/ui\n\n1. **Licensing first.** links-visuals is Unlicense and can be ported now. For konard.github.io, ask the\n   owner to add an Unlicense LICENSE before any code is moved. The sound engine and palettes are already\n   Unlicense through immortality.\n2. **Schema in Links Notation.** Express each RULES entry as links, for example:\n   ```\n   (liquid.blur: (type range) (default 18) (min 0) (max 40) (unit px))\n   (skin.name: (type select) (default glass) (options glass liquid futuristic))\n   ```\n   Then generate the JS and TS rule tables, and the Swift and Kotlin constants, from it. Store user diffs as\n   Links Notation too: `(liquid.blur 24)`. Keep JSON import for backward compatibility with existing\n   `settings` and `settings-presets` values and `#settings=` links.\n3. **Keep the projection contract.** Write `--section-key` CSS variables and `data-section-key` attributes,\n   and keep the before-paint injection for web targets. Native targets get the same normalized map as an\n   observable store.\n4. **Scopes.** Keep the user/document split (localStorage vs URL or `.lino`), and add an element scope so the\n   designer mode can override tokens per node in the DOM-like tree.\n5. **Controls.** Port Select, ColorInput, NumberInput, Tooltip and numericKeys with their tests (`*.test.jsx`)\n   as the first `controls` set. Keep WAI-ARIA APG behaviour and the Safari fixes.\n6. **Links view.** Merge the K:src/links glyph, placement, collisions and render code with the L:js\n   zoom-pan, grid, anchors and IK into a single renderer:\n   - one marker set, with SVG and Canvas back ends generated from it\n   - no global state; instance objects instead\n   - D3 bundled and pinned, or dropped where `d3-force` alone is enough\n   - an idle-stopping animation loop\n7. **Parsing.** Replace the regex parser with the official `links-notation` package. Keep `configurations.js`\n   (code and index maths, Burnside counting) as a pure utility.\n8. **i18n.** Move the `{en, ru}` literals into per-language catalogs keyed by id, preferably in Links\n   Notation, and keep `plural.js` rules per language.\n9. **Themes.** Treat `glass`, `liquid` and `futuristic`, plus the 12 palettes and the corner/frame generator,\n   as the first theme pack. Classic UIs (Windows 9x, Aqua and so on) become more theme packs on the same\n   tokens. Fix #47-style corner and edge transparency in the generator, not in per-skin CSS.\n10. **Animation recording.** Reuse the export pipeline: one model goes to a standalone SVG and then to a\n    raster, over a timeline of settings and link diffs. The IK animation in links-visuals and the canvas\n    backgrounds are the first recording targets.\n11. **Process.** Adopt the per-issue test files, the three-engine Playwright runs, a case study per issue,\n    and the 1500-line limit. Do not commit logs or archives, so the framework repo does not grow to hundreds\n    of megabytes.",

Configurability model (konard.github.io)\n\nThis is the most mature part of the two repos and the strongest candidate for the core of link-foundation/ui.\n\n1. **The schema is a list of sections of flat fields.**\n   - Defined in [K:src/settings/schema.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/schema.js).\n   - A section is `{id, column, title:{en,ru}, lead, fields, when(settings), tabs}`.\n   - A field is created by a factory in [K:src/settings/fields.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/fields.js):\n     - `range(key, d, min, max, step, label, extra)`\n     - `toggle(...)`\n     - `select(key, d, options, label)` with `option(value, en, ru)`\n     - `color(...)`\n   - Keys are dotted paths such as `liquid.blur`, `skin.name`, `ui.cornerTL`. They are already link-like\n     (`section.key`) and would map one-to-one onto Links Notation doublets.\n   - The sections are:\n     - motion, nebula, stars, grid, beams, rain, sound\n     - skins: glass, liquid, futuristic, materials, palettes, corners\n     - ui: control sizes, borders, per-corner radii (−1 means \"follow the skin\"), menu size, slider track\n     - theory: `theory.notation` chooses L→L² or R→R²\n   - Split files: `schema.ui.js`, `schema.skins.js`, `schema.background.js`, `schema.layers.js`,\n     `schema.materials.js`, `schema.sound.js`.\n   - There are about 114 factory call sites; loops generate hundreds of fields, many of them script-only\n     (`css:false`).\n2. **One rule table.**\n   - `RULES` maps each key to `{d, min, max, u, o, c}`: default, limits, unit, options, colour flag.\n   - `CSS_RULES` is the subset that is projected into CSS.\n   - `DEFAULTS` and `PREVIOUS_DEFAULTS` are exported.\n   - [K:src/settings/schema.defaults.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/schema.defaults.js)\n     holds `DEFAULT_LOOK`, the JSON the owner pasted in issue #45 (\"That is defaults.\").\n3. **Normalization and migration.**\n   - Lives in [K:src/settings/apply.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/apply.js).\n   - `normalize(rules, stored)` clamps numbers, drops unknown options and validates `#rrggbb` colours.\n   - It also migrates old values, for example `future.surface: 'transparent'` becomes a solid surface with\n     opacity 0.\n4. **Projection into the DOM, without the framework.** `applySettings(root, rules, settings)` writes:\n   - numbers and colours as CSS variables on `<html>` (`liquid.blur` becomes `--liquid-blur: 18px`)\n   - selects and toggles as `data-*` attributes (`skin.name` becomes `data-skin-name=\"glass\"`)\n   - derived values: corner-radius fallbacks, `--ui-accent-rgb`, an SVG `feTurbulence` noise data-URI, and\n     `data-surface-invisible`\n\n   All styling is then plain CSS that keys off these variables and attributes.\n\n5. **Before-paint script.**\n   - `normalize` and `applySettings` are serialized with `Function.toString` into `SETTINGS_SCRIPT`.\n   - The `themeBeforePaint` Vite plugin prepends it into `<head>` together with `THEME_SCRIPT`\n     ([K:vite.config.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/vite.config.js)).\n   - This avoids a flash of the wrong theme or skin, and it is the same code as at runtime, not a copy.\n6. **Store.**\n   - [K:src/settings/store.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/store.js)\n     is built on `useSyncExternalStore`. It has no context provider.\n   - **Only the diff from defaults** is stored, in localStorage `settings`. Users who never touched a key\n     therefore get improved defaults automatically.\n   - Other tabs stay in sync through the `storage` event.\n   - API: `setSettings(patch)`, `resetSettings(keys)`, `changesOf`.\n7. **Looks (presets).** Defined in [K:src/settings/presets.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/presets.js).\n   - Built-in presets: Matrix universe (default), glass-universe, calm, matrix, deep-space, warp,\n     neon (Tron), liquid, blueprint, and \"Light and fast\" for slow phones.\n   - `before45()` rebases old presets onto `PREVIOUS_DEFAULTS`.\n   - `COMFORT` lists keys that presets, shared links and Random never change:\n     `motion.mode`, `sound.on`, `sound.volume`, `theory.notation`, `ui.transparency`. These are\n     accessibility and preference keys; the idea comes from immortality's `src/settings.ts`.\n   - `randomLook()` never goes above the default cost on any heavy key (counts, fps, blur, glow).\n   - Saved looks are stored as `[{name, look}]` under `settings-presets`, with add, remove, import and rename.\n   - Sharing: `#settings=<urlencoded JSON>` (`shareLink`, `lookOfHash`). When a shared link is opened,\n     `openSharedLook()` applies it, saves the previous look as a \"Before the link\" preset, and strips the hash.\n8. **Preferences outside the schema.** [K:src/i18n/prefs.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/i18n/prefs.js)\n   - Language is resolved as `?lang`, then the stored value, then `navigator`, then `en`.\n   - Theme is auto/light/dark.\n   - Each is a tiny external store.\n   - All UI text is written inline as `{en, ru}` objects, and `plural.js` handles Russian plural forms.\n9. **The network editor's local style model.** [K:src/links/style.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/links/style.js)\n   - `STYLE_SECTIONS` reuses the same field factories.\n   - `normalizeStyle` validates; `styleToParams` and `styleFromParams` put **only non-default values in the\n     query string**.\n   - There are six link palettes: site, neon, pastel, warm, cold, print.\n   - The network uses the same configuration grammar as the site settings, but it is scoped to a document\n     (the URL) instead of the user (localStorage).\n10. **Settings page as live designer.** [K:src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx)\n    - The page is generated from the schema. Each row is `label | control | value | ↺ reset`, and changed\n      rows get an `is-changed` class.\n    - Layer tabs show a dot when that layer is active.\n    - There is a Reset button per section plus \"Reset everything\".\n    - \"Look at the background\" is a peek mode that hides the panels.\n    - The \"Your changes\" box shows the diff JSON with Copy, and has a paste area that loads either settings\n      or `{presets:[...]}`.\n    - It contradicts the framework goal of representing everything in Links\n   Notation.\n4. **Bilingual text is hard-coded** as `{en, ru}` objects inside components, including long templated\n   sentences in `NetworkEditor.jsx`. Adding a language means editing every component; there is no catalog.\n5. **Configuration is global only.** The tokens style every element of a kind. There is no per-instance\n   override and no element tree to select from, so it is not yet a WYSIWYG designer.\n6. **React-bound.** The store, pages and controls are React components; only `apply.js` and `src/links/*`\n   are framework-free.\n7. **Open issue #47.** The top-left corner and the top and bottom edges are not transparent by default,\n   although every other element is. These are still border/corner layering bugs from the #45 redesign.\n8. **Fixed bugs worth remembering.**\n   - #13: the rain sometimes scaled up too much on refresh.\n   - #45: some border configurations clipped overflowing content or broke transparent backgrounds and\n     selection.\n   - CSS multicol was unreliable in Safari, so columns are explicit.\n   - Safari needed a focus fix in `numericKeys.js`.\n9. **Heavy generated CSS.** `skins.frames.css` is about 84 KB / 1067 lines, and a very large number of\n   fields (hundreds) costs payload and maintenance.\n10. **Repo weight.** About 372 MB, from case studies, logs and archives committed to the repo, so it is\n    slow to clone. Sparse clones are needed.\n11. **Migrations are ad hoc** (`before45()`, special cases in `normalize`). There is no versioned schema\n    migration mechanism.\n\n### links-visuals\n\n1. **CDN at runtime.** D3 is fetched from `esm.sh/use-m` on every load. It does not work offline, it is\n   unpinned and therefore a supply-chain risk, and it is not reproducible.\n2. **Global mutable state** in `state.mjs` (module singletons with setters). Two views cannot share a page.\n3. **Duplicated renderers.** `canvas-render.mjs` re-implements the SVG markers and paths by hand, and the\n   two can drift apart.\n4. **A rAF loop runs every frame even when idle** (`animation.mjs`), which wastes battery.\n5. **Inline CSS is copied into every HTML page**, with no theming. Markers are hardcoded black, and only\n   grid.html and draw.html have colour.\n6. **Experiments are not composable.** Each page wires modules differently, and `failed-attempts/` holds 76\n   HTML snapshots instead of git history.\n7. **Limits of the network model.** grid.html places links in cells without real references. Only draw.html\n   has link-to-link anchors, and only to centers (no source/target-to-endpoint semantics, no layout engine).\n8. **Fixed bugs worth remembering.**\n   - #1/#3: start-point snapping.\n   - #15: the grid was not infinite.\n   - #19/#21: zoom failed away from the center because the hit area was the SVG; listeners were moved to\n     `document`.\n   - #23/#28: grid proportions were inconsistent with single-link mode.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Migration notes for link-foundation/ui\n\n1. **Licensing first.** links-visuals is Unlicense and can be ported now. For konard.github.io, ask the\n   owner to add an Unlicense LICENSE before any code is moved. The sound engine and palettes are already\n   Unlicense through immortality.\n2. **Schema in Links Notation.** Express each RULES entry as links, for example:\n   ```\n   (liquid.blur: (type range) (default 18) (min 0) (max 40) (unit px))\n   (skin.name: (type select) (default glass) (options glass liquid futuristic))\n   ```\n   Then generate the JS and TS rule tables, and the Swift and Kotlin constants, from it. Store user diffs as\n   Links Notation too: `(liquid.blur 24)`. Keep JSON import for backward compatibility with existing\n   `settings` and `settings-presets` values and `#settings=` links.\n3. **Keep the projection contract.** Write `--section-key` CSS variables and `data-section-key` attributes,\n   and keep the before-paint injection for web targets. Configurability model (konard.github.io)\n105\t\n106\tThis is the most mature part of the two repos and the strongest candidate for the core of link-foundation/ui.\n107\t\n108\t1. **The schema is a list of sections of flat fields.**\n109\t   - Defined in [K:src/settings/schema.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/schema.js).\n110\t   - A section is `{id, column, title:{en,ru}, lead, fields, when(settings), tabs}`.\n111\t   - A field is created by a factory in [K:src/settings/fields.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/fields.js):\n112\t     - `range(key, d, min, max, step, label, extra)`\n113\t     - `toggle(...)`\n114\t     - `select(key, d, options, label)` with `option(value, en, ru)`\n115\t     - `color(...)`\n116\t   - Keys are dotted paths such as `liquid.blur`, `skin.name`, `ui.cornerTL`. They are already link-like\n117\t     (`section.key`) and would map one-to-one onto Links Notation doublets.\n118\t   - The sections are:\n119\t     - motion, nebula, stars, grid, beams, rain, sound\n120\t     - skins: glass, liquid, futuristic, materials, palettes, corners\n121\t     - ui: control sizes, borders, per-corner radii (−1 means \"follow the skin\"), menu size, slider track\n122\t     - theory: `theory.notation` chooses L→L² or R→R²\n123\t   - Split files: `schema.ui.js`, `schema.skins.js`, `schema.background.js`, `schema.layers.js`,\n124\t     `schema.materials.js`, `schema.sound.js`.\n125\t   - There are about 114 factory call sites; loops generate hundreds of fields, many of them script-only\n126\t     (`css:false`).\n127\t2. **One rule table.**\n128\t   - `RULES` maps each key to `{d, min, max, u, o, c}`: default, limits, unit, options, colour flag.\n129\t   - `CSS_RULES` is the subset that is projected into CSS.\n130\t   - `DEFAULTS` and `PREVIOUS_DEFAULTS` are exported.\n131\t   - [K:src/settings/schema.defaults.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/schema.defaults.js)\n132\t     holds `DEFAULT_LOOK`, the JSON the owner pasted in issue #45 (\"That is defaults.\").\n133\t3. **Normalization and migration.**\n134\t   - Lives in [K:src/settings/apply.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/apply.js).\n135\t   - `normalize(rules, stored)` clamps numbers, drops unknown options and validates `#rrggbb` colours.\n136\t   - It also migrates old values, for example `future.surface: 'transparent'` becomes a solid surface with\n137\t     opacity 0.\n138\t4. **Projection into the DOM, without the framework.** `applySettings(root, rules, settings)` writes:\n139\t   - numbers and colours as CSS variables on `<html>` (`liquid.blur` becomes `--liquid-blur: 18px`)\n140\t   - selects and toggles as `data-*` attributes (`skin.name` becomes `data-skin-name=\"glass\"`)\n141\t   - derived values: corner-radius fallbacks, `--ui-accent-rgb`, an SVG `feTurbulence` noise data-URI, and\n142\t     `data-surface-invisible`\n143\t\n144\t   All styling is then plain CSS that keys off these variables and attributes.\n145\t\n146\t5. **Before-paint script.**\n147\t   - `normalize` and `applySettings` are serialized with `Function.toString` into `SETTINGS_SCRIPT`.\n148\t   - The `themeBeforePaint` Vite plugin prepends it into `<head>` together with `THEME_SCRIPT`\n149\t     ([K:vite.config.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/vite.config.js)).\n150\t   - This avoids a flash of the wrong theme or skin, and it is the same code as at runtime, not a copy.\n151\t6. **Store.**\n152\t   - [K:src/settings/store.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/store.js)\n153\t     is built on `useSyncExternalStore`. It has no context provider.\n154\t   - **Only the diff from defaults** is stored, in localStorage `settings`. Users who never touched a key\n155\t     therefore get improved defaults automatically.\n156\t   - Other tabs stay in sync through the `storage` event.\n157\t   - API: `setSettings(patch)`, `resetSettings(keys)`, `changesOf`.\n158\t7. **Looks (presets).** Defined in [K:src/settings/presets.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/presets.js).\n159\t   - Built-in presets: Matrix universe (default), glass-universe, calm, matrix, deep-space, warp,\n160\t     neon (Tron), liquid, blueprint, and \"Light and fast\" for slow phones.\n161\t   - `before45()` rebases old presets onto `PREVIOUS_DEFAULTS`.\n162\t   - `COMFORT` lists keys that presets, shared links and Random never change:\n163\t     `motion.mode`, `sound.on`, `sound.volume`, `theory.notation`, `ui.transparency`. These are\n164\t     accessibility and preference keys; the idea comes from immortality's `src/settings.ts`.\n165\t   - `randomLook()` never goes above the default cost on any heavy key (counts, fps, blur, glow).\n166\t   - Saved looks are stored as `[{name, look}]` under `settings-presets`, with add, remove, import and rename.\n167\t   - Sharing: `#settings=<urlencoded JSON>` (`shareLink`, `lookOfHash`). When a shared link is opened,\n168\t     `openSharedLook()` applies it, saves the previous look as a \"Before the link\" preset, and strips the hash.\n169\t8. **Preferences outside the schema.** [K:src/i18n/prefs.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/i18n/prefs.js)\n170\t   - Language is resolved as `?lang`, then the stored value, then `navigator`, then `en`.\n171\t   - Theme is auto/light/dark.\n172\t   - Each is a tiny external store.\n173\t   - All UI text is written inline as `{en, ru}` objects, and `plural.js` handles Russian plural forms.\n174\t9. **The network editor's local style model.** [K:src/links/style.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/links/style.js)\n175\t   - `STYLE_SECTIONS` reuses the same field factories.\n176\t   - `normalizeStyle` validates; `styleToParams` and `styleFromParams` put **only non-default values in the\n177\t     query string**.\n178\t   - There are six link palettes: site, neon, pastel, warm, cold, print.\n179\t   - The network uses the same configuration grammar as the site settings, but it is scoped to a document\n180\t     (the URL) instead of the user (localStorage).\n181\t10. **Settings page as live designer.** [K:src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx)\n182\t    - The page is generated from the schema. Each row is `label | control | value | ↺ reset`, and changed\n183\t      rows get an `is-changed` class.\n184\t    - Layer tabs show a dot when that layer is active.\n185\t    - There is a Reset button per section plus \"Reset everything\".\n186\t    - \"Look at the background\" is a peek mode that hides the panels.\n187\t    - The \"Your changes\" box shows the diff JSON with Copy, and has a paste area that loads either settings\n188\t      or `{presets:[...]}`.\n189\t    - Sounds have ▶ preview buttons.\n190\t    - The page itself is the preview: it includes `InterfacePreview`, `UiSamples` (small samples of every UI\n191\t      element, from #45), `MaterialPresets` and `CornerTiles`.\n192\t    - Columns are explicit because CSS multicol was buggy in Safari.\n193\t    - This is the closest existing thing to the \"VS-designer configuration mode\" the issue asks for, though\n194\t      it edits global tokens, not per-element instances.\n195\t11. **Testing every setting.** Issue #15 asked for proof that every setting is applied.\n196\t    [K:src/settings/applied.test.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/settings/applied.test.js)\n197\t    goes through every field in `FIELDS` and fails if a setting is used in none of three ways: as a CSS\n198\t    variable or `<html>` attribute that a stylesheet reads, as an option a background script reads, or as a\n199\t    key a component reads.\n200\t12. **Skins and frames.**\n201\t    - [K:src/skins.frames.js](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/main/src/skins.frames.js)\n202\t      defines corner shapes and corner lines once:\n203\t      - shapes: square, cut, tall, wide, round, scoop, notch\n204\t      - lines: none, gap, line, accent, bracket\n205\t    - `npm run build:frames` generates `skins.frames.css` from it, and the same definitions draw the\n206\t      `CornerTiles` previews. A test keeps the generated CSS in sync.\n207\t    - The CSS uses `@property` typed lengths and `:where()` to keep specificity at zero.\n208\t    - `schema.skins.js` has 12 palettes (from immortality) and the skins `glass`, `liquid`, `futuristic`.\n209\t    - Owner requirements from issues:\n210\t      - #39: a single transparency setting for all backgrounds; matte, glossy and liquid glass presets; no\n211\t        rounded corners in the futuristic look by default; rounded corners following t3code practice\n212\t      - #45: one per-side border configuration shared by panels, blocks, buttons and other elements; top\n213\t        highlight width set separately from corner/side widths; the corner layer above or below content;\n214\t        colours picked from palettes\n215\t\n216\t---\n217\t\n218\t## 3.
