[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+## Dependencies",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+- {{F10}} (blocker): `createConfig`, `set('user', 'settings', key, [value])`,",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+  `persistLayer`, `exportPatch`. Before it merges, keep values in a plain",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+  object and add `bindConfig` last.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+- Related: {{F06}} (`parse`), {{F07}} (colour/dimension coercion), {{F37}}",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+  (expects `SettingsSchema`, diff, presets, share encoding), {{F46}}, {{F57}}",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+  (JSON reader kept one release), {{F58}}, {{F63}}, {{F64}}.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+## Step-by-step plan",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+1. Create `packages/ui-settings/package.json`",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   (`\"name\": \"@link-foundation/ui-settings\"`), dependencies `ui-core`,",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `ui-config` (workspace).",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+2. `src/schema.js`: `readSchema(text) → { schema, diagnostics }`;",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   ```js",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   /** @typedef {{ key: string, type: string, default: unknown, label?: string, section?: string,",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+    *   min?: number, max?: number, step?: number, unit?: string, options?: string[],",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+    *   comfort: boolean, apply: Array<{ cssVar?: string, dataAttr?: string }> }} SettingField */",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   /** @typedef {{ version: number, fields: Map<string, SettingField>, sections: Section[],",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+    *   presets: Map<string, Preset>, migrations: Migration[] }} SettingsSchema */",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   ```",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   Report unknown types, defaults that fail their own coercion, duplicate keys.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+3. `src/coerce.js`: `coerce(field, raw) → { ok, value }` — clamp ranges, round",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   to `step`, choices must be members, colours must be `#rrggbb`, toggles accept",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `true`/`false`. Port from immortality `coerceAxisValue`.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+4. `src/values.js`: `defaults(schema)`, `merge(schema, base, untrusted) →",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   { values, rejected: string[] }` (drops unknown keys and invalid values, never",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   throws), `diff(schema, values)`, `isDefault`, `reset(schema, values, keys?)`,",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `countCustomized`, `equalValues` (structural, order-independent).",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+5. `src/presets.js`: `applyPreset(schema, values, id)` (keeps comfort fields),",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `activePreset(schema, values)` using `equalValues` (fixes the key-order bug).",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+6. `src/random.js`: `randomize(schema, values, { random, locked = new Set() })`;",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `random` is required (no `Math.random` inside); comfort and locked fields",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   are unchanged.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+7. `src/migrate.js`: `migrate(schema, stored)` applies `rename`, then drops",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   values equal to the `old-default` of their version (so users get new",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   defaults, as immortality does), then `merge`.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+8. `src/codec.js`: `toLino(schema, values)` (diff only, sorted by schema",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   order), `fromLino(schema, text)`, `fromLegacyJson(schema, json)`,",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `toShareHash(schema, values)`, `fromShareHash(schema, hash, viewerValues)`",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   — rejects input over 8 KiB, merges as untrusted, keeps viewer comfort",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   values.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+9. `src/dom.js`: `applyToRoot(schema, values, root)` sets",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `--liquid-blur: 18px` and `data-theme-mode=\"auto\"`;",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   `beforePaintScript(schema, { storageKey })` returns the source of a small",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   inline script that reads stored values, validates them with the serialised",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   rule table and applies them before first paint; `beforePaintScriptHash()`",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+   returns its `sha256-...` for a Content Security Policy.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+10. `src/testing.js`: `assertEverySettingUsed(schema, { css, sources })` —",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+    each field has an `apply` target found in the CSS text, or its key appears",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+    in one of the given source strings; the error lists unused keys.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+11. `src/config.js`: `bindConfig(config, schema, { target = 'settings' })`.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+12. README with the schema grammar and a migration guide from both sites.",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+## Files to create or change",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+",
[2026-11-01T12:01:44.296Z] [INFO]                 "+- `packages/ui-settings/package.json`, `README.md`, `src/index.js`, `src/index.d.ts`",

For\n[konard/immortality](https://github.com/konard/immortality) the look includes\nsound. Its\n[`app/src/sound.ts`](https://github.com/konard/immortality/blob/main/app/src/sound.ts)\n(Unlicense, so it can be ported) is a Web Audio synthesizer with:\n\n- 26 voices and 10 UI events (`hover`, `click`, `toggle`, `select`, `scan`,\n  `open`, `close`, `type`, `intro`, `notify`);\n- up to 6 voices per event, played in `random`, `cycle` or `layer` mode;\n- a bus of tone shelf → compressor/limiter → convolution reverb send, with\n  stereo panning from the pointer position;\n- a lazily created `AudioContext` (browsers block audio until a user gesture);\n- `throttledScan`, which limits repeated scan sounds;\n- an `onSoundCue` event bus that one animated background listens to;\n- per-voice provenance `{character, sourceLabel, sourceUrl}`; no audio files\n  are shipped, every sound is synthesized from code.\n\nComfort settings (sound on/off, volume) belong to the viewer: applying a\nshared look or preset must keep them and randomizing must not touch them\n([research](https://github.com/link-foundation/ui/blob/main/docs/case-studies/issue-1/research/immortality-and-anime-avatar.md),\n\"Sound as part of motion\" and \"Comfort settings stay local\"). No other\nroadmap issue covers sound; {{F64}} needs this issue to migrate immortality.\n\n## Goal\n\nA package `@link-foundation/ui-sound` that reads a sound theme written in\nLinks Notation, synthesizes its voices with Web Audio, and plays them for\nframework interaction events, with sound off by default, a viewer-owned\nvolume, and no effect on users who never enable it.\n\n## Scope\n\n### In scope\n\n- A LiNo sound theme format: voices (oscillator/noise graphs with envelopes),\n  event bindings with a mode, bus settings and provenance per voice.\n- A player: lazy `AudioContext` on the first user gesture, the three modes,\n  per-event throttling, pointer-positioned stereo, master volume and mute.\n- Binding to framework events from {{F25}} (the actions registry and state\n  machine transitions), plus a public `cue(name)` call and an `onCue`\n  subscription (the `onSoundCue` equivalent).\n- Comfort keys `sound.enabled` and `sound.volume` in the user layer of {{F10}},\n  marked so presets, shared looks and randomize never change them.\n- One default theme (`quiet`, 4–6 soft voices) and a port of the immortality\n  voices as a second theme with their provenance.\n\n### Out of scope\n\n- Audio files and music playback; speech output (screen readers already\n  speak); haptics.\n- A visual sound editor (a later designer issue may reuse the format).\n- Migrating immortality itself ({{F64}}).\n\n## Dependencies\n\n- {{F10}} (blocker): configuration layers. Consumed: the user layer and a way\n  to mark keys as comfort keys (if {{F10}} has no such flag, add a list of\n  comfort keys in this package and open a follow-up issue against {{F10}}).\n- {{F25}} (blocker): the actions registry and state machine events. Consumed:\n  an event subscription such as `onAction(name, handler)`; use the name that\n  is actually merged.\n- Related: {{F44}} (intro sequences may cue sounds on their timeline),\n  {{F45}} (recordings should store cues so a replay can play them), {{F39}}\n  (a theme may name its sound theme), {{F15}} (schema kinds for the settings\n  panel), {{F02}} (provenance records), {{F64}} (first consumer).\n\n## Step-by-step plan\n\n1. Create `packages/ui-sound/` (`\"name\": \"@link-foundation/ui-sound\"`,\n   `\"type\": \"module\"`), depending on `links-notation` and the framework core.\n2. Write `docs/spec/sound.md` and a sample theme, for example:\n\n   ```lino\n   (sound-theme quiet\n     (voice tick\n       (oscillator triangle (frequency 880))\n       (envelope (attack 0.002) (decay 0.04) (sustain 0) (release 0.02))\n       (gain 0.2)\n       (source (label 'own work') (license CC0-1.0)))\n     (voice soft-open\n       (oscillator sine (frequency 440) (glide 660 0.08))\n       (envelope (attack 0.01) (decay 0.12) (sustain 0) (release 0.05))\n       (gain 0.15)\n       (source (label 'own work') (license CC0-1.0)))\n     (event click (mode random) (voices tick))\n     (event open (mode cycle) (voices soft-open))\n     (event scan (throttle 120))\n     (bus (shelf 4000 -6) (compressor -18 4) (reverb 0.15)))\n   ```\n\n3. `src/theme.js`: parse the theme with `links-notation` into a plain object\n   and validate it (unknown keys → diagnostics, never a throw).\n4. `src/graph.js`: build an `AudioNode` graph for a voice from the plain\n   object. Accept the `BaseAudioContext` as a parameter so tests can pass an\n   `OfflineAudioContext` or a fake.\n5. `src/player.js`: `createSoundPlayer({ theme, config, now })`, with\n   `play(event, { x })`, `cue(name)`, `onCue(handler)`, `setVolume`, `mute`,\n   lazy context creation on the first `pointerdown`/`keydown`, modes and\n   throttling. Inject the clock (`now`) and the random source (seeded) so\n   tests are deterministic.\n6. `src/bind.js`: subscribe to the {{F25}} events and map them to sound events\n   (`press` → `click`, `open` → `open`, and so on) with a LiNo mapping table.\n7. Add the comfort keys to the {{F10}} user layer and exclude them from\n   presets, shared looks and randomize.\n8. Port the 26 immortality voices into `themes/immortality.lino`, one\n   `(source ...)` per voice taken from `SOUNDS` in `sound.ts`.\n9. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` only for sounds tied to motion\n   (`intro`, `scan`); never start sound before a user gesture.\n10. Write `packages/ui-sound/README.md` with the format, the API and the\n    accessibility rules.\n\n## Files to create or change\n\n- `packages/ui-sound/package.json`, `README.md`, `src/{index,theme,graph,player,bind}.js`, `src/index.d.ts`\n- `packages/ui-sound/themes/{quiet,immortality}.lino`\n- `packages/ui-sound/tests/{theme,graph,player,bind,comfort}.test.js`\n- `docs/spec/sound.md`\n- `.changeset/<name>.md`\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] `theme.test.js`: both bundled themes parse with no diagnostics; an\n      unknown voice key yields a diagnostic, not an exception.\n- [ ] `graph.test.js`: rendering `tick` in an `OfflineAudioContext` (or a fake\n      context recording node calls) creates the expected nodes and the output\n      is silent after attack + decay + release.\n- [ ] `player.test.js`: with a seeded random source, `random` mode picks the\n      same voice sequence on every run; `cycle` mode rotates; `layer` mode\n      plays all voices; `scan` plays at most once per 120 ms of injected time.\n- [ ] No `AudioContext` is created before a simulated user gesture, and none\n      at all while `sound.enabled` is false (the default).\n- [ ] `comfort.test.js`: applying a preset or a shared look and randomizing\n      leave `sound.enabled` and `sound.volume` unchanged.\n- [ ] `bind.test.js`: a {{F25}} `press` action plays the `click` event once.\n- [ ] Every voice in `themes/immortality.lino` has a `(source ...)` record.\n- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`,\n      `npm run check:duplication` pass.\n\n## How to verify\n\n```bash\nnpm install\nnode --test packages/ui-sound/tests/*.test.js\nnpm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:duplication\n```\n\nFor a manual check, open a page that uses the player, enable sound in the\nsettings, click a button and open a dialog: each plays its voice once, and\nreloading the page keeps the volume.\n\n## Prior art and libraries\n\n- `konard/immortality` `app/src/sound.ts` (Unlicense): event → voices,\n  modes, bus, provenance, lazy context.\n- The Web Audio API (MDN): `OscillatorNode`, `GainNode`,\n  `DynamicsCompressorNode`, `ConvolverNode`, `StereoPannerNode`,\n  `OfflineAudioContext` for tests.\n- Optional: [Tone.js](https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js) (MIT) as a reference\n  for envelopes; do not add it as a dependency unless the plain Web Audio\n  version becomes too complex (check the licence and size first).\n\n## References\n\n- https://github.com/konard/immortality/blob/main/app/src/sound.ts\n- https://github.com/link-foundation/ui/blob/main/docs/case-studies/issue-1/research/immortality-and-anime-avatar.md\n- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Audio_API\n- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Media/Autoplay_guide\n"

No other\nroadmap issue covers sound; {{F64}} needs this issue to migrate immortality.\n\n## Goal\n\nA package `@link-foundation/ui-sound` that reads a sound theme written in\nLinks Notation, synthesizes its voices with Web Audio, and plays them for\nframework interaction events, with sound off by default, a viewer-owned\nvolume, and no effect on users who never enable it.\n\n## Scope\n\n### In scope\n\n- A LiNo sound theme format: voices (oscillator/noise graphs with envelopes),\n  event bindings with a mode, bus settings and provenance per voice.\n- A player: lazy `AudioContext` on the first user gesture, the three modes,\n  per-event throttling, pointer-positioned stereo, master volume and mute.\n- Binding to framework events from {{F25}} (the actions registry and state\n  machine transitions), plus a public `cue(name)` call and an `onCue`\n  subscription (the `onSoundCue` equivalent).\n- Comfort keys `sound.enabled` and `sound.volume` in the user layer of {{F10}},\n  marked so presets, shared looks and randomize never change them.\n- One default theme (`quiet`, 4–6 soft voices) and a port of the immortality\n  voices as a second theme with their provenance.\n\n### Out of scope\n\n- Audio files and music playback; speech output (screen readers already\n  speak); haptics.\n- A visual sound editor (a later designer issue may reuse the format).\n- Migrating immortality itself ({{F64}}).\n\n## Dependencies\n\n- {{F10}} (blocker): configuration layers. Consumed: the user layer and a way\n  to mark keys as comfort keys (if {{F10}} has no such flag, add a list of\n  comfort keys in this package and open a follow-up issue against {{F10}}).\n- {{F25}} (blocker): the actions registry and state machine events. Consumed:\n  an event subscription such as `onAction(name, handler)`; use the name that\n  is actually merged.\n- Related: {{F44}} (intro sequences may cue sounds on their timeline),\n  {{F45}} (recordings should store cues so a replay can play them), {{F39}}\n  (a theme may name its sound theme), {{F15}} (schema kinds for the settings\n  panel), {{F02}} (provenance records), {{F64}} (first consumer).\n\n## Step-by-step plan\n\n1. Create `packages/ui-sound/` (`\"name\": \"@link-foundation/ui-sound\"`,\n   `\"type\": \"module\"`), depending on `links-notation` and the framework core.\n2. Write `docs/spec/sound.md` and a sample theme, for example:\n\n   ```lino\n   (sound-theme quiet\n     (voice tick\n       (oscillator triangle (frequency 880))\n       (envelope (attack 0.002) (decay 0.04) (sustain 0) (release 0.02))\n       (gain 0.2)\n       (source (label 'own work') (license CC0-1.0)))\n     (voice soft-open\n       (oscillator sine (frequency 440) (glide 660 0.08))\n       (envelope (attack 0.01) (decay 0.12) (sustain 0) (release 0.05))\n       (gain 0.15)\n       (source (label 'own work') (license CC0-1.0)))\n     (event click (mode random) (voices tick))\n     (event open (mode cycle) (voices soft-open))\n     (event scan (throttle 120))\n     (bus (shelf 4000 -6) (compressor -18 4) (reverb 0.15)))\n   ```\n\n3. `src/theme.js`: parse the theme with `links-notation` into a plain object\n   and validate it (unknown keys → diagnostics, never a throw).\n4. `src/graph.js`: build an `AudioNode` graph for a voice from the plain\n   object. Accept the `BaseAudioContext` as a parameter so tests can pass an\n   `OfflineAudioContext` or a fake.\n5. `src/player.js`: `createSoundPlayer({ theme, config, now })`, with\n   `play(event, { x })`, `cue(name)`, `onCue(handler)`, `setVolume`, `mute`,\n   lazy context creation on the first `pointerdown`/`keydown`, modes and\n   throttling. Inject the clock (`now`) and the random source (seeded) so\n   tests are deterministic.\n6. `src/bind.js`: subscribe to the {{F25}} events and map them to sound events\n   (`press` → `click`, `open` → `open`, and so on) with a LiNo mapping table.\n7. Add the comfort keys to the {{F10}} user layer and exclude them from\n   presets, shared looks and randomize.\n8. Port the 26 immortality voices into `themes/immortality.lino`, one\n   `(source ...)` per voice taken from `SOUNDS` in `sound.ts`.\n9. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` only for sounds tied to motion\n   (`intro`, `scan`); never start sound before a user gesture.\n10. Write `packages/ui-sound/README.md` with the format, the API and the\n    accessibility rules.\n\n## Files to create or change\n\n- `packages/ui-sound/package.json`, `README.md`, `src/{index,theme,graph,player,bind}.js`, `src/index.d.ts`\n- `packages/ui-sound/themes/{quiet,immortality}.lino`\n- `packages/ui-sound/tests/{theme,graph,player,bind,comfort}.test.js`\n- `docs/spec/sound.md`\n- `.changeset/<name>.md`\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] `theme.test.js`: both bundled themes parse with no diagnostics; an\n      unknown voice key yields a diagnostic, not an exception.\n- [ ] `graph.test.js`: rendering `tick` in an `OfflineAudioContext` (or a fake\n      context recording node calls) creates the expected nodes and the output\n      is silent after attack + decay + release.\n- [ ] `player.test.js`: with a seeded random source, `random` mode picks the\n      same voice sequence on every run; `cycle` mode rotates; `layer` mode\n      plays all voices; `scan` plays at most once per 120 ms of injected time.\n- [ ] No `AudioContext` is created before a simulated user gesture, and none\n      at all while `sound.enabled` is false (the default).\n- [ ] `comfort.test.js`: applying a preset or a shared look and randomizing\n      leave `sound.enabled` and `sound.volume` unchanged.\n- [ ] `bind.test.js`: a {{F25}} `press` action plays the `click` event once.\n- [ ] Every voice in `themes/immortality.lino` has a `(source ...)` record.\n- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`,\n      `npm run check:duplication` pass.\n\n## How to verify\n\n```bash\nnpm install\nnode --test packages/ui-sound/tests/*.test.js\nnpm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:duplication\n```\n\nFor a manual check, open a page that uses the player, enable sound in the\nsettings, click a button and open a dialog: each plays its voice once, and\nreloading the page keeps the volume.\n\n## Prior art and libraries\n\n- `konard/immortality` `app/src/sound.ts` (Unlicense): event → voices,\n  modes, bus, provenance, lazy context.\n- The Web Audio API (MDN): `OscillatorNode`, `GainNode`,\n  `DynamicsCompressorNode`, `ConvolverNode`, `StereoPannerNode`,\n  `OfflineAudioContext` for tests.\n- Optional: [Tone.js](https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js) (MIT) as a reference\n  for envelopes; do not add it as a dependency unless the plain Web Audio\n  version becomes too complex (check the licence and size first).\n\n## References\n\n- https://github.com/konard/immortality/blob/main/app/src/sound.ts\n- https://github.com/link-foundation/ui/blob/main/docs/case-studies/issue-1/research/immortality-and-anime-avatar.md\n- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Audio_API\n- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Media/Autoplay_guide\n"
